text:
olivia: Heads-up — Veridian wants to lock in the upgrade (50 seats) but procurement needs a staged acceptance plan. They asked for a 6mo discounted pilot then automatic convert to annual. Needs decision by EOD to keep SE enablement slot next week.
james: 6mo pilot ok from PM if price is clear. what's the discount band they expect?
olivia: they verbally asked for 20% off for the 6mo, then full price on conversion. finance raised concerns about churn.
anya: legal flagged signer authority — primary signer is OOO until Mon. They asked if delegated signer can sign the amendment.
legal-bot: Quick check: delegated signing allowed if we have an executed Delegation of Authority or a PO showing delegated signer. Recommend one-pager addendum.
miguel: For execution, propose Docusign + witness flow. If procurement insists on wet-sign, build that into timeline. :calendar:
procurement-bot: Received request. Drafting PO template with vendor code and delegated signer field. ETA 3h.
james: Also need SE to hold enablement week of Apr 10-14. If EOD decision misses, we risk losing slot.
olivia: Customer prefers invoice split: 50% upfront for pilot, remainder on convert. Finance prefers upfront full. Thoughts?
anya: Risk tradeoff — partial upfront reduces sticker shock but increases admin overhead. Recommend 50% upfront + card on-file for conversion.
miguel: From onboarding POV 50% upfront + confirmed SE dates is workable. We can scope a condensed enablement if confirm now.
olivia: I'll send two options to the buyer: (A) 6mo at -20% with 50% upfront, Docusign delegated-signer addendum, SE week hold; (B) Annual convert at standard price with full upfront invoice and guaranteed SE.
james: I'll attach updated quote + SOW, include a short paragraph about conversion billing mechanics.
procurement-team: Draft PO sent to olivia@veridian.com, included delegated signer field and KMS billing reference.
olivia: Customer replied: "Option A looks best, can we expedite the delegated signer form? Our CFO signs on Tue."
anya: I'll prep the delegation package and legal addendum now, send for internal review.
legal-bot: Addendum template: 
```text
Delegation of Signature Authority — party X authorizes Y to sign Amendment A on behalf of Organization. Effective dates, scope, and sample signature block included.
```
olivia: please cc procurement contact when sending. Also capturing enablement follow ups: 1) hold SE week (Apr10-14) 2) delegated-signer addendum executed by Tue 3) PO receipt + 50% upfront payment processed 4) Docusign fallback plan if bank requires wet-sign.
james: pinging @finance for final approval on 50% upfront concession. :pray:
procurement-team: Noted. Will route PO to billing after addendum lands.
miguel: I'll tentatively reserve SE resources for Apr10-14, will shrink scope if timeline slips.
olivia: Great — I'll update the buyer now and post final thread here once signed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
